---
title: "R Notebook"
output: html_notebook
---


```{r}

library(magick)

# input images 

# img_path2 <- "../figures/booster_shots_policy.png"
img_path1 <- "../figures/reprod_numb.png"
img_path2 <- "../figures/vax_scenarios.png"
# img_path3 <- "../figures/timevarying_props_reprod_numb.png"


# read images (original resolution preserved)
img1 <- image_read(img_path1)
img2 <- image_read(img_path2)
# img3 <- image_read(img_path3)


# match widths by padding 
w1 <- image_info(img1)$width
w2 <- image_info(img2)$width
# w3 <- image_info(img3)$width
target_w <- max(w1, w2)

pad_to_width <- function(img, target_w) {
  image_extent(
    img,
    geometry = paste0(target_w, "x", image_info(img)$height),
    gravity  = "center",
    color    = "white"
  )
}

img1 <- pad_to_width(img1, target_w)
img2 <- pad_to_width(img2, target_w)
# img3 <- pad_to_width(img3, target_w)


# stack vertically (original heights kept) 
combined_img <- image_append(c(img1, img2), stack = TRUE)

# save stacked image (no resizing, no re-rendering) 
image_write(
  combined_img,
  path   = "../figures/figure1.png",
  format = "png"
)

```



```{r}
library(magick)

img_path1 <- "../figures/reprod_numb.png"    # Panel A (reference)
img_path2 <- "../figures/vax_scenarios.png"  # Panel B

img1 <- image_read(img_path1)
img2 <- image_read(img_path2)

# match Panel B to Panel A's width by scaling (not padding)
target_w <- image_info(img1)$width
img2 <- image_resize(img2, geometry = paste0(target_w, "x"))

# stack: Panel A on top, Panel B below
combined_img <- image_append(c(img1, img2), stack = TRUE)

image_write(combined_img, path = "../figures/figure1.png", format = "png")
```
